review_candidates.description: Work Location: Remote U.S. Based Reporting Hours: Eastern Business Hours Clearance: Not required Travel: Not required. Geo cgi is looking for a Proposal Specialist to support our U.S. government contracts capture and proposal activities. You’ll take ownership of our most complex pursuits from kickoff through submission, shaping proposal strategy, developing client-focused win themes, and ensuring every proposal is clear, compelling, and fully compliant. You will coordinate with recruiting, and work side-by-side with capture managers and technical subject matter experts. You will work under the direct supervision of the director of business development and will consult with company leadership to translate pursuit strategy into winning submissions. This role calls for U.S. federal government capture support and proposal management experience. Proposal management experience and the ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits under tight deadlines are required. This position is a remote opportunity with the preferred hours of performance being eastern time zone. Key Responsibilities Managing proposals end-to-end, from kickoff through final delivery Leading responses to requests for information (RFIs) and sources sought Analyzing request for proposals (RFPs) and building-out response templates, compliance matrixes, and proposal schedules Collaborating with technical staff and capture managers to shape pursuit strategy, develop win themes, and associated client-aligned messaging Drafting, editing, and customizing resumes, project descriptions, firm narratives, executive summaries, and other proposal materials Liaising with teaming partners and subconsultants on multi-company pursuits Facilitating go/no-go decisions, kickoff meetings, pink/red team reviews, and post-submission retrospectives Keeping data current in the business development (BD) pipeline and contributing to ongoing marketing content development Ensuring consistency of win themes and messaging across all proposal and presentation materials Leveraging knowledge management platforms and artificial intelligence (AI) resources to streamline content development, organization, and compliance tracking Tracking opportunity websites and flagging strategic opportunities for further review Supporting the rollout of proposal quality and compliance standards aligned with geocgi's brand and style guidelines Guiding and mentoring capture managers in bid and proposal best practices Benefits As an employee of geo cgi, the Proposal Specialist will have access to a generous benefits package, in addition to a corporate culture and community of GIS geeks. Our benefits include but are not limited to: Competitive salaries, commensurate with experience and leading Federal Contractors in the geospatial industry. Opportunities for upward mobility in a dynamic fast paced environment within a small company. Merit-based spot and end of year bonuses. Safe Harbor 401(k) plan with immediate vesting. Flexible work hours and PTO. Enjoy 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for individual employees. Coverage extensions for spouses and child dependents are available for purchase through the company plan. Company paid training, certifications, and professional growth and development. The Following Are Requirements Of The Proposal Specialist U.S. Citizen. Minimum 3 years of experience supporting U.S. government contract capture and proposal support. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Geography, GIS, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or 10+ years of experience in government contracting proposal management Well-versed in bid and proposal best practices Experienced in U.S. federal government contract forecasts and procurement websites, portals, vehicles, etc. Proficient in MS Teams, SharePoint, and on-line, collaborative proposal development Proficient in proposal compliance matrix development and compliance check processes Ability to directly and indirectly facilitate the writing of compliant and compelling proposals Experience supporting multi-company proposals Exceptional writing, editing, and verbal communication skills Strong organization, time management, and detail orientation Ability to interpret complex RFPs and develop compliance structures and pursuit strategies The Following Are Preferred Of The Proposal Specialist Certified by the Association of Proposal Management Professionals (APMP) Hold other bid and proposal management certification(s) (i.e., Shipley, etc.) Experience in Information Technology professional services to the U.S. government U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) support experience Experience submitting proposals for government-wide acquisition contracts (GWACs) Experience responding to task order solicitations on GWACs The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $90,000-$110,000 USD. review_candidates.title: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays
review_candidates.company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

review_candidates.description: Location: Fully Remote (Must be currently based in Portugal; no relocation assistance provided) Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week, 5 days a week, rotative shifts) Equipment: Fully provided by the company Are you fluent in Hebrew and looking to advance your career from anywhere in Portugal? We are seeking enthusiastic Hebrew-Speaking Content Moderators to join our international team on a fully remote basis. In this role, you will be supporting a world-leading platform, helping its global community of users enjoy a safe, seamless digital experience while maintaining online environment standards. What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities) As a Content Moderator, you will play a crucial role in maintaining platform safety, ensuring appropriate platform guidelines and policies are upheld across all digital channels. Your daily tasks will include: Content Review & Policy Enforcement: Review user-generated content in Hebrew to ensure alignment with platform guidelines, safety policies, and best practices, maintaining a healthy and respectful online environment. Problem Solving: Identify and resolve safety concerns, flagged content issues, account access requests, and complex technical policy questions with fairness and sound judgment. Data Accuracy: Document and log reviews and administrative decisions accurately in our internal systems to keep operational workflows smooth and well-documented. Quality & Metrics: Strive to consistently meet and exceed individual and team performance targets, such as accuracy benchmarks, response efficiency, and quality guidelines. What We Are Looking For (Requirements) To be successful in this role, you must meet the following criteria: Location & Work Status: Must be strictly based in Portugal. You must hold EU Citizenship OR a valid Portuguese Residency Card (Título de Residência). Please note: Visa sponsorship and relocation packages are not available for this role. Language Skills: Fluent level of Hebrew (both written and spoken) AND a solid B2 level of English to navigate training, internal systems, and communicate effectively with international colleagues. Adaptability: Ability to work rotative shifts (5 days a week, 8 hours a day) from your dedicated home office environment. Tech Savviness: Comfortable using computers, navigating multiple browser tabs simultaneously, and learning new internal software applications quickly. Soft Skills: Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment, active listening, and a proactive mindset toward problem-solving. Prior Experience: Previous experience in content moderation, customer service, or online operations is nice to have, but not mandatory. We provide comprehensive, fully paid training to set you up for success! Salary & Package Salary: 1,767 EUR gross per month (paid over 12 months) Work Setup: 100% remote working environment within Portugal Hardware: All required hardware and work equipment will be delivered directly to your address in Portugal What We Offer (Perks & Benefits) Paid Training: Complete, professional onboarding and virtual training program to teach you everything you need to know about internal policies, systems, and workflow best practices. Remote Flexibility: Work comfortably from your home anywhere in Portugal without the hassle of a daily commute. Multicultural Environment: Work alongside peers from all over the world in a highly collaborative, inclusive, and diverse virtual network. Career Growth: Clear paths for internal promotion into quality assurance, team management, specialized policy moderation, or training roles. If you are based in Portugal, ready to take on a meaningful remote role, and represent a global brand, we want to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Head of Finance
review_candidates.description: Company Description S'hail Shipping & Maritime Services is Qatar's largest owner of dry bulk carriers, transporting dry bulk commodities across global markets. The company plays a key role in supporting regional and international trade through reliable and efficient maritime operations. As a leading player in the shipping industry, S'hail offers opportunities to work on complex, high-impact financial and operational initiatives. Team members join a dynamic environment that values professionalism, safety, and strong corporate governance. The organization is committed to sustainable growth and developing talent within the maritime and logistics sectors. Role Description The Head of Finance is a full-time, on-site role based in Doha, We are inviting highly motivated and well-established CFA to head our Finance, which among others involve- Banking and loan management, cash management, conducting financial analysis of new investments/ projects, reporting and compliance (including MIS, Board agenda/ presentations on financial health). Prior experience in shipping industry and derivatives will be an added advantage. Qualifications Strong foundation in Finance, with proven experience in corporate or maritime/shipping finance leadership roles. Ability to prepare and interpret Financial Statements and perform accurate Financial Reporting. Demonstrated Analytical Skills to support strategic decision-making and performance analysis. Experience in Budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting for complex organizations. Proficiency with ERP systems and advanced Excel or financial modeling tools. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; professional certifications such as CFA, are required. Proven leadership and team management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments. Strong communication and presentation skills, and the ability to convey complex financial information clearly to stakeholders. Experience in the shipping, maritime, or logistics industry is highly desirable.

review_candidates.title: Head of Design
review_candidates.description: About The Role As Head of Design at 4C Strategies, you will lead a small, distributed team of designers and strengthen our design capability across product experiences, user workflows, and cross-functional collaboration. This is a hands-on leadership role: you are a skilled designer who both leads the team and keeps doing design work yourself, helping the team do their best work. Based in our Stockholm office, you will play a central role in shaping how design contributes to product strategy, customer value, and delivery across our Exonaut platform — our software for readiness and resilience — and related services. This role focuses on our Defence products, designing for armed forces and defence planners. You will be responsible for building structure, quality, and consistency across the design function — balancing strategic direction with hands-on leadership and operational execution. The role involves close collaboration with Product Management, Engineering, Delivery Consultancy, and customer-facing teams to ensure user-centred, intuitive, and reliable solutions that support mission-critical environments. As Head of Design, you will support and develop designers, strengthen design processes and governance, and ensure alignment between business priorities, customer needs, and product usability. You will help establish design as a key capability within 4C’s continued growth journey. The role at a glance Location: Stockholm, Sweden (hybrid working). Travel: mainly regular travel to our Malmö office, plus 2–3 trips abroad per year (for example to our London, Warminster, or Orlando offices). Reports to: Chief Technology & Product Officer (CTPO). Team: a team of 3 designers, based in Malmö and Orlando (USA). Focus: Defence products, designing for armed forces and defence planners. Employment type: full-time, permanent (6-month probation). Key Responsibilities Work hands-on as a designer on key Defence product areas, contributing your own craft and raising quality together with the team. Lead and develop the team through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and clear development plans, creating growth opportunities for each designer. Champion design quality, accessibility, and consistency across products, workflows, and customer-facing experiences. Improve design processes, design-system standards, and ways of working across cross-functional teams. Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering to align user experience, technical feasibility, and business priorities. Turn customer and user insights — from continuous discovery and research — into intuitive, effective products, and measure success through clear outcomes and shared goals. Contribute to product strategy, keeping user-centred thinking at the heart of decisions, and set clear design principles for AI-enabled features (transparency, user control, and safe fallback options). Recruit and onboard designers, and support their growth through our design career framework, building an inclusive and collaborative team culture. About You You are an experienced design leader who combines deep user-centred thinking with structure, collaboration, and business understanding. You are comfortable operating in complex product environments where balancing user needs, technical realities, and organisational priorities is essential. You enjoy building clarity and consistency across teams and processes while supporting designers in their growth and development. You are pragmatic, communicative, and motivated by improving both product experiences and ways of working. You lead by example — both doing design work and growing your team — and you measure your success by your team's quality, cohesion, and growth. We believe you bring Experience leading or coaching designers within SaaS, technology, or product-driven organisations. A solid understanding of product design, UX, interaction design, and user-centred methods. Experience building and improving scalable design processes, systems, and governance. Experience collaborating with Product Management and Engineering teams in cross-functional environments. Experience developing designers through coaching, feedback, and regular 1:1s. Comfortable leading a distributed team across different locations and time zones. Clear communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to build alignment across teams and organisational levels. Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution in fast-moving environments. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage several projects at once. High proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Fluent Swedish, both written and spoken. Swedish citizenship, because this role supports defence work and the successful candidate must pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). Desirable: Experience working with complex B2B platforms or mission-critical software environments. Familiarity with design systems and scalable product design practices. Experience working in international or multi-disciplinary organisations. Experience supporting organisational change and design maturity growth. Formal education or training within UX, interaction design, service design, or related disciplines. You do not need to tick every box. If you meet most of these points and are excited about the role, we would love to hear from you. A few requirements for this role — such as Swedish citizenship and security vetting — come only from the security rules for defence work, not from personal preference. What We Offer Occupational pension (tjänstepension). Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag). Healthcare insurance & healthcare insurance for treatment Parental pay Vaccinations Room to grow into a Director-level design leadership role over time. A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission-critical work. About 4C Strategies 4C Strategies is a global provider of readiness and resilience solutions, supporting organisations across defence, public sector, corporate, and critical infrastructure environments. Through our Exonaut platform and expert services, we help organisations train, exercise, evaluate, and improve their operational capability and preparedness. At 4C, we combine technology, expertise, and collaboration to solve complex challenges in mission-critical environments. Our teams work closely together across disciplines to create user-focused solutions that strengthen resilience and operational performance worldwide. How To Apply To apply, click the Apply today button. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.
